description: Transform components/booking/AppointmentTicketView.tsx into high-contrast world-class digital pass with slate-900 header band (not emerald-700), emerald-600 Queue ID section, uppercase tracking-widest row labels, thicker amber warning (border-l-[6px]), slate-700 screenshot note, and full-width emerald CTA button
steps: 1. Update card wrapper: max-w-2xl mx-auto, border-4 border-slate-300 (thicker border), rounded-sm, overflow-hidden, shadow-2xl.

2. Update header band: slate-900 bg (not emerald-700), py-6 px-6, border-b-4 border-emerald-600. Left side: seal image (48×48) + 'AMAI PAKPAK MEDICAL CENTER' (text-lg, font-bold, white, uppercase, tracking-wide) + 'Outpatient Department' subtitle (slate-300, text-xs). Right side: 'CONFIRMED' badge - white border-2 border-white text-white font-bold uppercase text-xs px-4 py-2 rounded-sm. Add seal Image import (48×48, public/Amai_Pakpak_Medical_Center_seal.png).

3. Update Queue ID section: emerald-600 bg (not emerald-50), py-6 px-6, border-b-2 border-emerald-700. Label: 'QUEUE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER' (uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs, emerald-200, font-bold, mb-2). Queue ID: text-4xl font-mono font-black white tracking-widest.

4. Update patient details rows: white bg, px-6 py-3, each row border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0. Use existing TicketRow component but update styling: Label column - uppercase tracking-widest text-xs slate-400 font-semibold w-40. Value column - text-sm font-semibold slate-900. Keep existing rows (PATIENT NAME, CONSULTATION TYPE, ASSIGNED OFFICE, APPOINTMENT DATE with formatDateLong, TIME SLOT with formatTimeRange).

5. Update operational warnings section: px-6 py-6 space-y-4. Amber box: border-l-[6px] border-amber-500 (thicker) bg-amber-50 p-5 rounded-sm. '⚠ MANDATORY ARRIVAL POLICY' (uppercase, tracking-wide, text-xs, amber-900, font-bold, mb-2). Warning text: text-sm amber-800 leading-relaxed. Screenshot note: slate-700 bg (bg-slate-700, not slate-50) text-slate-50 p-4 rounded-sm text-sm flex items-start gap-2: '📷' + 'Screenshot or save this ticket for your records. No SMS confirmation will be sent.'

6. Update footer action button: px-6 pb-6. Button: full-width emerald-700 hover:emerald-800 uppercase font-bold tracking-wide py-4 text-sm rounded-sm 'BOOK ANOTHER APPOINTMENT'. Keep existing onReset handler.

All existing formatting functions (formatDateLong, formatTimeRange, CATEGORY_LABELS) work unchanged
